messages:
Marta - Procurement: Quick one 4e2d VectorLane sent renewal with a weird per-dimension surcharge. Need a fast read: cost delta vs current, and whether we can push for a waiver. Doc: https://drive.google.com/vectorlane-quote. @Diego @Noor @Eve

Diego (Finance): Paste the two pricing lines here plz. We should calc 12mo TCO.

Marta - Procurement: Snippet:
```
Baseline (Pure Usage): $0.000017/embed
High-Dim Addendum: vectors >1024 dims billed at 1.25x
12mo term, NET30, monthly billing
```

Noor (ML Eng): We produce 140M embeddings/mo at 1536 dims. With 1.25x that bills like 175M -> monthly cost w/o discount = 175M * 0.000017 = $2,975/mo (~$35.7k/yr). Baseline without multiplier = ~$28.6k/yr. Multiplier is material.

Eve (Legal): Need to challenge the unilateral multiplier in contract. Ask for clear threshold, audit rights, and removal if we commit to 12mo or to a hybrid reserved pool.

VectorLane Rep: Hi team ":wave:" We can: (A) waive multiplier if you sign a 12mo commit >=1B/year, or (B) reduce multiplier to 1.10x for enterprise customers, or (C) offer a hybrid: 100M included @ $0.000012/embed + overlay at baseline rate with no multiplier. Will send revised quote + sample invoice and meter spec.

Diego (Finance): Hybrid option sounds promising. Request a sample peak-month invoice showing included vs overlay lines, and an annual cap on price increases.

Noor (ML Eng): Also ask for p95 latency at our QPS for high-dim vectors; if latency suffers we need credits. Confirm how batching is metered (by vector count or API call).

Marta - Procurement: Great. @Procurement-Bot open PR when revised quote arrives and include approvers: Diego (Finance), Eve (Legal), Security.

Procurement-Bot: Created PR #590: "VectorLane renewal - high-dim surcharge review". Link: https://procurement.internal/pr/590

Marta - Procurement: Thanks all. I'll post the vendor docs when received and we can decide. :thumbsup:
